I'm not an Imgur/Reddit shill by any means. I just want to stop this before it gets out of hand, since Voat likes to do that sometimes. I want to address a couple concerns people have with Imgur and try to maybe convince you that maybe it isn't *literally* Hitler.

The arguments

1.. Imgur and Reddit are the same thing

The administration may or may not be the same, but they way they are operated are *fundamentally* different. Reddit has shown in the past that they have no problem removing and censoring content that they don't agree with. That's not really up for debate. Imgur on the other hand, hasn't really done that, at least not with your private pictures. The only time that Imgur will remove your uploaded content (correct me if I'm wrong) is if you make it available on their front page, or if it gets a DMCA takedown request. Your content /should be/ safe on Imgur.

2.. Imgur is insecure

Everyone fucks up. Nothing is 100% secure. I can almost guarantee that if Veuwer or Slimgr had as many active users as Imgur, someone will find a critical exploit with them as well. What matters is how Imgur handled the situation, and I have to say they handled it pretty well. Within a week, the exploit was fixed. That's what really matters here.

3.. Imgur is slow/clunky/whatever

It's not. Really. As long as you direct link to the image themselves, and not the Imgur page around it, you should experience a speedy image load.

4.. Imgur in unreliable

From my experiences with the alternatives that people use around here, Imgur is very reliable by comparison.

What to take from this post

I'm not saying everyone should use Imgur. Use whatever you're comfortable with. I'm asking that you don't shit on people for using one image host over the other. I'm asking that you don't unsubscribe/block a sub just because part of their CSS links to Imgur. It's childish, petty, and isn't a decent reason to get mad over. Just live and let live. If you have a serious problem with any site, just block it in your hosts file or browser extension of your choice, and move on. It's really that simple.

If anything I've said here isn't true, or if I'm missing something please feel free to let me know, I'll update my post accordingly.
Reddit and Imgur are *not* the same thing. Please don't make this the next thing to get angry about.
